about: Hosts from which live.promptugal.news may embed an operator's own player. A camera is embedded only when data.promptugal.news's register says embedding is allowed, its terms say so, and its embed URL's host is listed here. live.b@PrompTugal.dinis adds a host by hand after reading that operator's terms; each entry names the operator, the terms URL and the date read. An entry with a path_prefix allows only that path on the host (for a shared host such as Amazon S3); kinds lists the views reviewed (iframe, video, image).

hosts.operator: Transport for London (TfL): JamCams, its official traffic cameras

terms.read_by: Dinis Cruz, in a browser (tfl.gov.uk answers agents with a bot check), pasted in data.b@PrompTugal.dinis's session about 23:10 UTC (PrompTugal__News__Data board/team/data/briefs/2026-11-18-dinis-commercial-line-ine-tfl.md)
terms.summary: Based on the Open Government Licence v2.0 with TfL amendments: free to copy, publish, distribute and transmit, adapt, and exploit commercially and non-commercially; must credit 'Powered by TfL Open Data' and 'Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database rights 2016' and 'Geomni UK Map data © and database rights [2019]'; follow TfL's branding guidelines; at most 500 calls a minute per feed; never suggest TfL's endorsement.

hosts.why_the_path: s3-eu-west-1.amazonaws.com serves every AWS customer's buckets in that region; only TfL's JamCam folder is allowed, in the build and in each page's Content Security Policy.
